purpose: Matched development pilot testing reliable commitment--release against capacity-matched controls.

arms.full: correct public reliability plus action-conditioned opportunity alignment
arms.phase_control: same capacity and Q fitting, but no opportunity-to-actor alignment
arms.permuted_reliability: same capacity and alignment, with the two public reliability bands swapped only inside the planning context

primary_endpoint: per-seed weighted_service_value, primary_completed and future_completed separately in r0.90 and r0.25 bands
mechanism_endpoint: pre-arrival forecast versus contingency fractions and post-arrival future-service release fraction
decision_rule: Advance only if the full arm exceeds at least one matched control on the primary endpoint in two of three seeds and its action pattern is directionally compatible with the public-reliability hypothesis, without a material primary-service or energy collapse.
interpretation_boundary: M1 is development only. It selects whether the frozen mechanism earns formal cohort evaluation; it is not pooled with a future formal cohort.
